chunks.subject: AP Macroeconomics
chunks.title: Q3 Short FRQ (5 points) — Set 1: real vs. nominal GDP, AD-AS & fiscal multiplier
chunks.content: AP Macroeconomics FRQ 3 (Short), 5 points, one per element, including a calculation. Set 1 answer key highlights: state that real GDP in 2021 equaled nominal GDP in 2021 and explain that the base-year price index is 100; draw a correctly labeled AD-AS graph showing PL1 and the relevant equilibrium; calculate the minimum change in government spending (a decrease of $8) and SHOW WORK (spending multiplier). Common failure: calculation without shown work (loses the point); AD-AS graph unlabeled; explaining the real=nominal relationship without the base-year reasoning.

chunks.content: Q3 (Set 1) scored 5/5 — stated and explained the real=nominal GDP relationship (base year), drew a correctly labeled AD-AS graph, and calculated the $8 spending decrease with shown work. Full-credit model.
